name: orca
title: Orca
description: Unofficial extension for the Orca agent orchestrator: see which agents are waiting for input and start new ones
author: dmitry_s

commands.name: list-agents
commands.title: List All Agents
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: List every Claude/Codex agent running in Orca, grouped by project

commands.name: agents-summary
commands.title: Show Waiting Agents
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Keeps the count of agents waiting for input in the root search, refreshed in the background

commands.name: add-prompt
commands.title: Add Prompt
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Save a prompt as a named Raycast command that starts an agent in Orca

commands.name: run-prompt
commands.title: Run Prompt
commands.subtitle: Orca
commands.description: Runs a saved prompt; opens the builder when started without one

preferences.name: summaryMode
preferences.title: Root Search Subtitle
preferences.description: What the Orca Agents command shows under its name in the root search, refreshed in the background every minute. It does not affect List All Agents — that command opens on all agents, with the blocked ones on top, and its own dropdown narrows the view.

data.title: Blocked Sessions, by Project and Name

preferences.name: agentFilter
preferences.title: Agent Types
preferences.description: Which panes count as agents worth listing.

preferences.name: orcaPath
preferences.title: Orca CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the orca executable. Defaults to the one bundled with Orca.app.
